description: The 12 defects planted in broken-launch.html, each with the rule it breaks and the checker that finds it. scripts/verify.mjs runs every checker named here that the shipped skill holds, against the page served by a 200-only server, and requires exactly these error rules from it: each listed rule reported as an error (with the match text in its where or measured field), and no other error rule of that checker. A defect's alsoRaises lists errors that follow directly from it; they must be reported too and are not counted as unplanned. Each case checks the defects of its own rules; defects whose part is not in the tree are reported as not run.

defects.defect: an SF font stylesheet requested from fonts.invalid and SF Pro first in the stack
a marquee that loops for ever with no pause control and ignores reduced motion
a hero intro without a timeout that ignores a page loaded scrolled
body text at about 3.6:1 on white
a scrub scene that pins and loads its film under reduced motion
a naive seek driver that writes currentTime while seeking
a plain-src film served by a 200-only server
an autoplay attribute on a below-the-fold clip

alsoRaises.reason: the autoplaying clip also loops, so it has no pause control and starts under reduced motion

defects.defect: an eager poster on a below-the-fold clip
an AAC track in a muted clip
a clip whose only source is HEVC
